name: investigating-claims
description: Investigates a quantitative claim about a population - "X% of group Y do Z", "group A is over-represented in B" - with a reproducible census or sample, fair comparison groups and a layered plain-English report. Use when fact-checking a viral statistic, auditing a claimed share, rate or over-representation, choosing a baseline or comparison group, steelmanning both readings of a disparity, or turning an analysis into a report for non-specialists. Not for judging a single conclusion's evidential strength (prove-it) or for prose editing alone (govuk-style).
